title: Stochastic LQ Optimal Control with Random Coefficients and a Terminal Mean-Field Cost
summary: This paper investigates a multidimensional non-homogeneous stochastic linear-quadratic optimal control problem featuring random coefficients and a terminal mean-field term in the cost functional, enabling its direct application to mean-variance models in financial engineering. Employing the Lagrangian duality method together with a decomposition approach for linear backward stochastic differential equations, we provide two types of sufficient conditions for solvability and derive the corresponding optimal controls.
